answer_1.quote: In this short paper we have proposed the Controlled TExt generation Relational Memory GAN (CTERM-GAN), a model aiming to generate sentences that are both syntactically correct and semantically coherent.

answer_2.quote: As evaluation measures, we have adopted corpus BLEU to assess syntactic quality and the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence between the topic used for conditioning and the topic extracted from the generated sentence to assess semantic coherence.
